notes.front: What is a database administrator (DBA)?
notes.back: The person responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining and running database systems, on-premises and in the cloud.
notes.explanation: The role covers the operational side of databases, from performance to backups and security.
notes.example: The person a hospital calls when its patient records system is slow or needs restoring.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Database Administrator
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What is a data engineer?
notes.back: Someone who works with stakeholders to design and implement data workloads: ingestion pipelines, cleansing and transformation, and analytical data stores.
notes.explanation: The training describes the role as managing the infrastructure and processes for data integration across the organisation.
notes.example: The person who builds the nightly process that gathers a chain’s shop sales into one place for analysis.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What is a data analyst?
notes.back: Someone who helps a business get the most value from its data by exploring it and building models, reports and visualisations.
notes.explanation: Their charts and reports help organisations make informed decisions.
notes.example: The person who produces the monthly charts a board uses to judge which products to keep.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Analyst
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What is an AI engineer?
notes.back: Someone who builds and integrates features powered by artificial intelligence into applications and data workflows.
notes.explanation: The role works with large language models, machine learning pipelines and data sources.
notes.example: The person who adds a feature that drafts replies to customer emails inside a firm’s support tool.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, AI Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What is Microsoft Foundry?
notes.back: Microsoft’s unified Azure platform as a service for enterprise AI operations, model builders and application development.
notes.explanation: It provides the tools, model access and infrastructure that AI engineers, and developers generally, use to design, test and deploy intelligent solutions.
notes.example: Where a team would build and test an assistant that answers staff questions from company data before releasing it.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Microsoft Foundry
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which data role is responsible for the overall availability and consistent performance of databases?
notes.back: The database administrator.
notes.explanation: Looking after databases once they are running, including their optimisation, is central to the role.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Database Administrator
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which data role works with stakeholders on backup and recovery plans for recovering from natural disasters or human error?
notes.back: The database administrator.
notes.explanation: The training lists storing backups and restoring data after a failure among the role’s key tasks.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Database Administrator
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which data role manages the security of data in a database, granting or denying users access to it?
notes.back: The database administrator.
notes.explanation: Assigning permissions to users is one of the tasks the training gives the role.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Database Administrator
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What responsibility for data privacy does a data engineer hold?
notes.back: Making sure privacy is maintained in the cloud, and across stores spanning on-premises and cloud.
notes.explanation: The training lists this alongside designing pipelines and analytical stores.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which data role owns the management and monitoring of data pipelines, so that data loads perform as expected?
notes.back: The data engineer.
notes.explanation: Data engineers also build those pipelines in the first place.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What are two kinds of data platform technology a data engineer works with?
notes.back: Nonrelational databases and data streams, among others.
notes.explanation: The training says the role uses a wide range, also naming relational databases and file stores.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which data role is responsible for exploring data to identify trends and relationships?
notes.back: The data analyst.
notes.explanation: The analyst then builds analytical models, reports and visualisations on what they find.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Analyst
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What does a data analyst turn raw data into, and on what basis?
notes.back: Relevant insights, based on identified business requirements.
notes.explanation: The aim is to maximise the value the business gets from its data.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Analyst
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What are two intelligent scenarios an AI engineer enables?
notes.back: Chat over an organisation’s own data, and content generation, among others.
notes.explanation: The training also names automated classification as one such scenario.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, AI Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which two further data-related roles does the training mention beyond its key roles?
notes.back: Data scientist and data architect.
notes.explanation: It adds that application developers and software engineers also work with data.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, AI Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Must each data role be filled by a different person?
notes.back: No; in some organisations the same person performs several roles.
notes.explanation: The roles define distinct tasks and responsibilities, and organisations may also name them differently.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: For what does the training say data engineers use Azure Storage?
notes.back: To host data lakes: blob storage with a hierarchical namespace that organises files in folders.
notes.explanation: The hierarchical namespace turns blob storage into a distributed file system.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Azure Storage
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: What kind of platform is Microsoft Fabric, and what does it bring together?
notes.back: A unified software-as-a-service analytics platform that brings the main data workloads together in one browser-based workspace.
notes.explanation: It combines data engineering, data warehousing, real-time analytics, data science and reporting on one shared storage layer, OneLake.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Microsoft Fabric
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which role does the training say builds Azure Stream Analytics into architectures, and to do what?
notes.back: Data engineers, to capture streaming data for an analytical store or for real-time visualisation.
notes.explanation: The service applies a query to a stream of input data and writes the results to an output.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Azure Stream Analytics
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which role does the training say uses Azure Data Explorer, and for what kind of data?
notes.back: Data analysts, for data with a timestamp attribute, such as log files and device telemetry.
notes.explanation: The service offers high-performance querying of log and telemetry data.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Azure Data Explorer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A developer accidentally deletes a table of customer orders, and it must be restored from last night’s backup. Which role would normally do this?
notes.choices:
A) Data analyst
B) AI engineer
C) Database administrator
D) Data engineer
notes.back: C: the database administrator.
notes.explanation: Backup and recovery of databases is one of the database administrator’s core responsibilities.
notes.choicesExplained: A explores and reports on data. B builds features powered by artificial intelligence. D builds and runs pipelines between systems.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Database Administrator
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A charity needs a nightly process that pulls donations from three systems, removes duplicates and loads them into an analytical store. Which role builds it?
notes.choices:
A) Database administrator
B) Data engineer
C) Data analyst
D) AI engineer
notes.back: B: the data engineer.
notes.explanation: Ingestion pipelines, cleansing and analytical data stores are exactly the workloads a data engineer designs.
notes.choicesExplained: A manages databases, their backups and access. C analyses the data once it has arrived. D builds features powered by artificial intelligence.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A sales director wants an interactive report showing which regions’ sales are rising and which are falling. Which role would build it?
notes.choices:
A) Data engineer
B) Database administrator
C) Data analyst
D) AI engineer
notes.back: C: the data analyst.
notes.explanation: Finding trends and presenting them in reports and visualisations is the data analyst’s job.
notes.choicesExplained: A prepares and moves the data. B keeps the databases available and secure. D builds features powered by artificial intelligence.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, Data Analyst
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A law firm wants an assistant that answers staff questions using its own case documents, built and tested in Microsoft Foundry. Which role leads the work?
notes.choices:
A) AI engineer
B) Data analyst
C) Database administrator
D) Data engineer
notes.back: A: the AI engineer.
notes.explanation: Chat over an organisation’s own data is one of the scenarios the training says AI engineers enable.
notes.choicesExplained: B builds reports and visualisations. C manages databases. D prepares the data, and the training says AI engineers work with data engineers on that.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”, AI Engineer
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A company’s booking application stores its transactions in Azure Database for MySQL. Which role typically manages that database?
notes.choices:
A) Data analyst
B) Database administrator
C) AI engineer
D) Data engineer
notes.back: B: the database administrator.
notes.explanation: The training says database administrators manage open-source relational databases to support transactional applications.
notes.choicesExplained: A may report on the data, and D may use the database as a source for pipelines, but neither manages it. C builds features powered by artificial intelligence.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Open-source databases in Azure
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: Which role typically uses Azure Data Factory to build ETL solutions that fill analytical stores from transactional systems?
notes.choices:
A) Data analyst
B) Data engineer
C) Database administrator
D) AI engineer
notes.back: B: the data engineer.
notes.explanation: Azure Data Factory defines and schedules pipelines that transfer and transform data, which is data engineering work.
notes.choicesExplained: A consumes the analytical data. C manages the transactional databases the pipelines draw from. D builds features powered by artificial intelligence.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Azure Data Factory
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: A bank wants to map its data and track data lineage across many systems to enforce data governance. Which role typically uses Microsoft Purview for this?
notes.choices:
A) AI engineer
B) Data analyst
C) Database administrator
D) Data engineer
notes.back: D: the data engineer.
notes.explanation: The training says data engineers use Microsoft Purview to enforce governance and keep analytical data trustworthy.
notes.choicesExplained: A builds features powered by artificial intelligence. B analyses the trusted data that governance helps find. C manages individual databases.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Identify data services”, Microsoft Purview
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words

notes.front: How does a data engineer’s focus differ from a database administrator’s?
notes.back: A database administrator runs and secures databases; a data engineer builds pipelines that move and transform data between systems.
notes.explanation: The two meet where a transactional database becomes the source for an analytical pipeline.
notes.source: Microsoft Learn, “Explore job roles in the world of data”
notes.sourceLicence: C · facts only, in our own words
